title: COMPASS: Utility Customer Mapping and Segmentation
description: Built a full-stack web app at Southern California Edison that lets analysts map, profile, and segment utility customers with overlays like fire risk, assistance programs, and solar usage. Designed daily ETL jobs into pre-aggregated warehouse tables, a cached FastAPI service, and a React + TypeScript map interface.

title: Persuasive vs. Deceptive Data Visualization
description: Designed two opposing visualizations from World Bank education spending data across 150+ countries to argue for and against whether governments prioritize university over primary students. Documented each design choice on a deceptive-to-earnest scale and wrote a reflection on where persuasion becomes misleading. Group project with three teammates.

title: Grocery Food Processing and Price Visualization
description: Analyzed 50K+ products from Walmart, Target, and Whole Foods to compare the cost of a day's calories for the most and least processed foods in each aisle. Designed a dot plot benchmarked against the average SNAP benefit, showing that highly processed foods were cheaper in 36 of 42 aisles.

title: Recipe Rating Prediction and Fairness Audit
description: Investigated whether calorie content predicts ratings across 81K+ food.com recipes, handling missing data with permutation tests and running hypothesis tests. Built a tuned scikit-learn classifier (0.966 F1) and confirmed it performed equally across recipe complexity groups.

title: Algorithmic Fairness Audit in Hiring Models
description: Audited logistic regression hiring models for gender and racial disparities in selection rates, then applied post-processing adjustments to close the gaps without retraining. Presented at the MURALS Undergraduate Research Conference under Professor Julian McAuley.

title: Dialogue Analysis of 236 Friends Episodes
description: Analyzed 8,400+ dialogue lines to study character dynamics, gender balance, and emotional tone across seasons using permutation tests and bootstrapping. Built a bigram model to generate episode titles and modeled IMDb rating against US viewership (r = 0.38).

title: Taylor Swift Song Recommender
description: Built a content-based recommender across 229 Taylor Swift songs that matches any track from a 763-song dataset to its closest Swift songs using Spotify audio features. Added TF-IDF keyword extraction and interactive widgets for exploring lyrics.

title: Autonomous Precision-Agriculture System
description: Co-authored research on a system pairing a drone for weed detection with a ground robot for removal. Trained YOLO/CNN models on annotated farm imagery and relayed GPS weed coordinates to a UR5e robotic arm for automated removal.

title: Predicting Pigeon Voting Behavior
description: Surveyed 40 campus pigeons on local policy issues using breadcrumb placement as ballots. Found strong support for more outdoor seating and zero interest in parking reform.

title: Cloud Shape Classifier
description: Trained a model to label clouds as dragons, ducks, or 'just a blob.' Achieved 100% accuracy on the 'just a blob' category and 3% on everything else.

title: Optimizing Sock Disappearance Rates
description: Tracked 200 socks across 60 laundry loads to estimate where missing socks go. Results point to a statistically significant portal behind the dryer.

title: Houseplant Social Network
description: Built a messaging app that lets houseplants send each other passive-aggressive texts about who gets the window spot. The fern has blocked everyone.
